description:
Update a webhook endpoint

Changes the destination URL, the subscription list or the enabled flag of an endpoint. Every field is optional and only the fields you send are touched. `events` is replaced wholesale, not merged, so send the complete list you want; each name is checked against the catalogue and an unknown one fails the whole request with 400. A new URL is resolved and refused if it points at a private or internal address. Setting `isActive` back to true is how you bring back an endpoint that was disabled automatically after repeated failures. The signing secret is not changed and cannot be rotated through this endpoint.

body.description: The fields to change. `events`, if sent, replaces the existing subscription list entirely.
